note: The happy path: a whole slideshow proposed in one call. Written as a template because a canned response cannot know the asset ids or the memories of a family that has not uploaded anything yet — the mock provider fills {{asset:N}} from the prompt's own photo list and {{memory:N}} / {{memoryFrom:N}} from its approved-memories list, and prunes anything it cannot fill. Keep the quote text as a placeholder: a literal string here would be a quote card nobody wrote, which is the exact failure the verbatim check exists to catch.
